title: External accounts
description: Review the Slack and Discord identities connected to your Azents account in each Workspace.
emptyDescription: Start from private Conversation settings in Slack or Discord when you want to connect an account.
inactiveDescription: Your Workspace membership is not active. This link cannot authorize account-based conversation settings.
elevationDisconnect: Verify your identity to disconnect {account} from {workspace}.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect external account?
disconnectDialog.description: Disconnect {account} from your Azents account in {workspace}.
disconnectDialog.impact: Future link-dependent controls will stop working in this Workspace. Existing guest access, messages, history, shared settings, grants, and blocks are preserved.

errors.membership_required: Join or accept an invitation to this Workspace before connecting.
errors.resource_not_found: This confirmation no longer matches the external account or browser session.
errors.expired: This confirmation has expired. Start again.
errors.conflict: This external account is already connected in this Workspace.
errors.candidate_not_ready: Enter the code in the original external service, then check the status again.
errors.candidate_terminal: This confirmation can no longer be used. Create a fresh code.
errors.busy: The connection service is temporarily busy. Try again.

confirmation.title: Confirm external account
confirmation.description: Connect only accounts that belong to you. Review the complete account pair before continuing.
confirmation.accountPairDescription: This connection applies only to the Workspace shown below.
confirmation.beforeCode: Creating a code does not connect the accounts. You must enter it in the original private Slack or Discord screen and confirm here afterward.
confirmation.codeSafety: Enter only this code from your own Azents screen. Never enter a code someone else sent you.
confirmation.enterInProvider: Return to the original private Slack or Discord screen and enter this code. Then come back here and check its status.
confirmation.providerVerified: The original external account entered this code. Review the account pair once more before connecting.
confirmation.elevationCreate: Verify your current Azents account before creating the one-time code.
confirmation.elevationConfirm: Verify your current Azents account before the final connection.
confirmation.connectedDescription: {account} is now connected to your Azents account in {workspace}.
confirmation.connectedImpact: Link-dependent controls can now use your current Azents authority. Existing guest permissions and conversation history are unchanged.
confirmation.notFoundDescription: This link is invalid or does not belong to your current account and browser session.
confirmation.errorDescription: Try again from the original private Slack or Discord screen.

cancelled.title: Confirmation cancelled
cancelled.description: Start a new connection from the original private Slack or Discord screen.

consumed.title: Confirmation already completed
consumed.description: Return to Slack or Discord, or review your external accounts in Account settings.

expired.title: Confirmation expired
expired.description: Start a new connection from the original private Slack or Discord screen.
